content: Unknown-field policy is a settled 3-state config across the ecosystem: pydantic model_config extra = ignore|allow|forbid (default ignore); marshmallow Meta.unknown = EXCLUDE|INCLUDE|RAISE; dataclasses-json undefined = Undefined.EXCLUDE|INCLUDE|RAISE with a CatchAll field to capture extras. All three cover EXTRA fields only. None of them offers a fourth 'observe and report' state, and none has any policy knob at all for MISSING or WRONG-TYPE fields other than raise -- those are the divergence classes with no ecosystem precedent.
